objective: Build a deterministic synthetic ED-to-ward-to-community composition test using the public ED runner, ED identity adapter, core transfer manager and minimal ward/community model. Cover accepted handover and delayed discharge; rejected and expired offers; cancellation after destination reservation; and right-censoring at the horizon.
steps: Run the unchanged nominal ED fixture through run_scenario and use its completed synthetic patient ticks as scenario timing inputs; use EdIdentityAdapter to bind the patient to one stable person and episode.
Drive one TransferManager lifecycle from ED to ward and a second lifecycle from ward to community for the same person and episode, using deterministic message IDs and virtual ticks.

Use ward_community::simulate to derive actual departure, arrival, handover, delayed ED admission, boarding, and horizon-censoring expectations; assert transfer claims and person ownership at each boundary.
Add independent negative paths for rejected offer, offer expiry, and cancellation after reservation; assert the origin claim remains and destination claims are released.
Run the focused ED integration target, both existing core contract targets, formatting and diff integrity.

verification.oracle: All composition cases execute and assert identity, transfer ownership/claims, delay and horizon behavior.
Existing transfer and ward/community contract coverage remains passing.

acceptance: The same synthetic person and episode traverse ED to ward and ward to community without duplicate identity or premature origin release.
Actual departure follows both community-place and transport availability; arrival and handover occur at explicit delayed ticks.
Rejection, expiry and cancellation retain origin ownership and do not leak destination claims.
Horizon truncation is right-censored and keeps the origin claim until handover.
No full ward, clinical validity, production scheduling, or PDES partitioning is claimed.
stop_conditions: A required core API or transition is missing
The same-scheduler conservation oracle cannot be expressed
Any edit escapes the listed write paths
